title: OnToPilot SQL migration log
description: Output of SqlMigrationCommand.ApplyAsync / RollbackAsync: timestamps for the run, the list of SQL steps applied with their SHA-256 checksums, and the per-table verify summary produced by verify.sql (row counts, FK orphan counts, business checksums). Task 4's Assert-AllMigrationManifests gate loads this file and validates its shape and content before allowing the cutover to proceed.

StartedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the migration run was initiated.

FinishedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the migration run finished (verify.sql included). May be null if the run crashed mid-step.

Steps.description: The list of SQL steps that were applied, each with the SHA-256 of its content. Idempotent re-runs append no new entries for steps already applied.

VerifySummary.description: Per-table verify output: row count, FK orphan count, and the deterministic business checksum.

AppliedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which this step was applied.

Checksum.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the SQL file's content at apply time.

Rows.description: One row per business table from verify.sql.

RowCount.description: Row count of the table after the migration.

OrphanCount.description: Count of foreign-key orphan rows for this table. Must be 0 for the cutover to proceed.

BusinessChecksum.description: Deterministic per-table business checksum (md5 over a stable column subset, in id order).
